findings.message: Round 1 Blocking Finding 1 (Sources): RESOLVED. Rohrer & Pashler (2012) is cited inline at the matched-teaching evidence verdict in topic-01.mdx:47-51 ("a thoughtful review of the data provides no support for style-based instruction"), sources/unit-07.md:16 registers the rohrer2012 row with its ERIC full-text link, coverage/unit-07.md:9 maps U7-1 to rohrer2012, and topic-01.mdx:172-177 Further Reading includes Rohrer & Pashler (2012) while appropriately scoping Spielman (2020) to Section 7.4.

Round 1 Blocking Finding 2 (Assessment blueprint spread): RESOLVED. The summative bank now conforms to the approved 5/5 blueprint spread across topics 7.1 and 7.2. MCQs: items 1, 2, 3, 4, 9 test Topic 7.1 (5 items); items 5, 6, 7, 8, 10 test Topic 7.2 (5 items). RRQs: items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 test Topic 7.1 (5 items); items 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 test Topic 7.2 (5 items). ERQs: items 1, 2 (Topic 7.1), items 3, 4 (Topic 7.2), item 5 (Integrative).

MCQ option key clustering: 8 of the 10 MCQ keys remain option (b) (unit-assessment.mdx:153-165; items 1-5, 7, 8, 10 are b; item 6 is c, item 9 is d). While improved by the addition of option (d) in item 9, option (b) continues to dominate. Recommended for future authoring pass to shuffle distractor positions.

Round 1 Advisory Finding 4 (Authority framing of practical work): RESOLVED. unit-teacher-notes.mdx:86-90 now explicitly qualifies the wheelchair walk as "the unit's instantiation of the course guide's course-generic group-assignment slot", accurately framing the classroom activity without over-attributing it to a chapter-specific guide directive.

Round 1 Advisory Finding 5 (Coverage reinforcement row U7-4): RESOLVED. In topic-02.mdx:111, fig-U7-4 comparison table compares slow, gifted, and disabled learners directly within the Inclusive education section, providing substantive reinforcement for gifted learner recognition and support (U7-4).
Round 1 Advisory Finding 6 (Bound-excerpt metadata in spielman2020.md): RESOLVED in commit 067c2ff2 during round 1.

Headless review environment execution: Visual inspection of figures and typography was performed via figure geometry measurement (measure-figure-text: zero glyph overflows or viewBox clip across all four figures and their dark/Urdu variants), SVG accessibility attribute verification (role="img", aria-labelledby, <title>, <desc>), alt text verification, table layout reachability analysis, and sharp rasterization to PNG.
